# Top 100 Medical AI-Ready Datasets 🧬🚀

> **QianfangHub (千方医数集) — the full-chain supplier of training data for medical AI.**  
> **Compliant, expert-grade data for medical AI.**

Welcome to **Top 100 Medical AI-Ready Datasets**! This repository is officially maintained by the [QianfangHub](https://www.qianfanghub.com/) team.

We curate **2,043 classic, AI-ready medical datasets** — spanning multi-modal imaging, electronic health records, genomics, drug discovery, medical NLP, physiological signals, public health and clinical trials. Every dataset listed here is **AI-ready**: structurally governed, de-identified and annotated for direct model training, research validation and clinical AI development. This repository is **permanently free** for academic labs, young scientists and AI startups.

---

## 🌐 About QianfangHub

**[QianfangHub](https://www.qianfanghub.com/)** is the **full-chain supplier of training data for medical AI**. It aggregates public medical datasets from across the web, engineers them into AI-Ready assets, and sources compliant specialty-disease data directly from Grade 3A hospitals — one chain covering search, governance and compliant delivery.

| Business line | What you get | Scale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 📂 **Public Medical Datasets** | Multi-modal public medical datasets, free search & download without login | **19 organ systems · 198,623 datasets** |
| ⚙️ **AI-Ready Datasets** | Structurally governed, ready-to-use training sets with summaries, tags and schema.org markup | **2,043 curated sets** |
| 🏥 **Specialty Disease Data (Data Mall)** | Grade 3A-sourced, expert-annotated, compliance-cleared disease-specific collections | **10 categories · delivery in as little as 4 weeks** |
| 📰 **Pharma & AI Frontiers** | Industry research, regulatory intelligence and product releases | **770 in-depth reports** |

- **Indexed public data items**: 124,538,937
- **Hospital network**: 11 Grade 3A hospitals and provincial health commissions
- **Modalities**: medical imaging · pathology · clinical text · lab tables · video · time-series · multi-modal
- **Compliance**: hospital ethics approval + informed consent, expert double-blind annotation, compliant out-of-domain delivery (federated learning / TEE)

👉 **[Public Datasets](https://www.qianfanghub.com/dataset)** · **[AI-Ready Datasets](https://www.qianfanghub.com/ai-ready-dataset)** · **[Data Mall](https://www.qianfanghub.com/data-mall)** · **[News](https://www.qianfanghub.com/pharma-frontiers)** · **[Request Custom Data](https://www.qianfanghub.com/service-consult)**

## 🤝 Custom & Commercial Medical Data

Beyond public datasets, QianfangHub sources **specialty-disease data directly from Grade 3A hospitals** with expert annotation and compliant out-of-domain delivery — closing the gap left by public data: insufficient scale, missing modalities and no long-term follow-up.

- **Free Consultation**: medical data experts evaluate feasibility and compliance options within 24 hours.
- **Free Samples**: 1–5 customized multi-modal samples delivered free for zero-cost blind testing.
- **Commercial Delivery**: **100 annotated entries minimum**, delivery in as little as 4 weeks — right-sized for papers, model cold-start and early target validation.

## 🌐 关于千方医数集（QianfangHub）

**千方医数集**是**医疗 AI 训练数据全链路供应商**：聚合全网公开医疗数据集，提供 AI-Ready 工程化治理，并支持三甲医院直采、专家标注、合规出域的专病数据供应与定制采集——检索、治理、合规交付一条链路贯通。

| 业务板块 | 你能得到什么 | 规模 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 📂 **公开数据集** | 多模态公开医疗数据集，免登录检索与下载 | **19 大系统 · 198,623 个数据集** |
| ⚙️ **AI-Ready 数据集** | 经结构化治理、即取即用的训练集，含摘要、标签与 schema.org 结构化标注 | **2,043 个工程化数据集** |
| 🏥 **医疗 AI 数据商城** | 三甲直采、专家标注、合规出域的专病交易集 | **10 类专病交易集 · 最快 4 周交付** |
| 📰 **医药 AI 前沿资讯** | 行业深度研报、监管动态与产品发布 | **770 篇研报** |

- **已索引公开数据项**：124,538,937
- **医院网络**：11 家三甲医院与省级卫健对接
- **模态覆盖**：医学影像 · 病理 · 临床文本 · 检验表格 · 视频 · 时序 · 多模态
- **合规体系**：医院伦理批件 + 知情同意，专家双盲标注，支持联邦学习 / 可信执行环境（TEE）实现「数据可用不可见」

👉 **[公开数据集](https://www.qianfanghub.com/dataset)** · **[AI-Ready 数据集](https://www.qianfanghub.com/ai-ready-dataset)** · **[数据商城](https://www.qianfanghub.com/data-mall)** · **[行业资讯](https://www.qianfanghub.com/pharma-frontiers)** · **[提交定制需求](https://www.qianfanghub.com/service-consult)**

## 🤝 专病数据定制与商业交付

除了公开数据集外，针对公开数据规模不足、模态缺失、无长期随访等痛点，千方提供**三甲医院直采、专家标注、合规出域**的专病数据供应与定制采集。

- **免费方案咨询**：医学数据专家 24 小时内免费评估数据可行性与合规治理方案。
- **免费样例提供**：免费清洗并交付 1–5 条定制化多模态样例数据，支持指定格式零成本盲测。
- **商业定制交付**：**100 条标注数据起订**，最快 4 周交付，适配课题组论文发表、模型冷启动与药企早期靶点验证。

👉 **[立即提交您的数据需求 🚀](https://www.qianfanghub.com/service-consult)**
